purpose: test whether finite forward transition consistency over the exact K3 three-stage predecessor codebook recovers the already-observed ABCD history that direct K3 endpoint decoding misclassifies as BACD, without any inverse solve
target_history_selection: same lexicographically first already-spent history fixed before all reverse-peeling outputs
predecessor_rule: for candidate final stage j enumerate the six permutations of the other three stages and reconstruct each predecessor from the degree-three ordered interaction basis; no target label or inverse iterate may alter these states
candidate_transition_rule: for each predecessor z and final stage j evaluate exactly one frozen-stage gradient and form q=z-eta*grad_L_j(z)
candidate_score: full-parameter FP64 L2 residual ||q-target|| with relative residual divided by max(1,||target||)
decision_rule: choose the unique full history with minimum forward-reachable residual; exact ties are non-identifiable and may not be broken lexicographically
reported_certificate: global runner-up residual minus best residual, plus half that margin as a target-only L2 noise radius
smoke_pass_requires_all: target endpoint hash exactly matches the frozen ABCD endpoint
the direct K3 baseline reproduces the already-observed BACD prediction and frozen errors within tolerance
all 24 forward-reachable candidate residuals are finite
exactly 24 candidate gradient evaluations are used
ABCD is the unique minimum-residual full history
the selected predecessor is ABC and selected final stage is D
the best relative residual is at most 1e-10
the global residual margin is strictly positive
anti_tuning_rules: do not change the target history, codebook, K3 basis degree, residual norm, numerical-zero threshold, or decision rule after observing output
do not add inverse iterations, line search, Hessian solves, or candidate-specific optimization
do not use the true ABC predecessor to construct or rank candidates; it may only be retained as a post-hoc reconstruction-error diagnostic
do not launch an all-24 reachable experiment unless this smoke passes
do not touch held-out confirmation codebooks

interpretation.pass: finite transition consistency rescues a pre-existing K3 chronology miss on one spent Pythia-14M history without inverse recovery; next freeze an all-24 spent-codebook reachable-margin map before any scalability or held-out claim
interpretation.fail: do not tune the residual decoder on this history; inspect the fixed candidate residual table and either revise the predecessor representation under a new frozen spent-data protocol or abandon this route

interpretation_scope: one spent-history mechanism smoke only; success does not establish all-history accuracy, polynomial scaling, held-out generalization, or novelty
